ns2:course.label: Twentieth Century America
ns2:course.description: One major emphasis on foreign policy, including the emergence of the United States as a great power after 1898; a second emphasis on the Progressive movement and recurrent attempts at the reform of American society; and racial and urban problems and the conservation of natural resources included.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Humanities - Hist & Phil, and Cultural Studies - Western course.
